Hello, root — I'm Sarah, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. First start, so the short version:

- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443 — CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the root certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** — I can have my own accounts, so you can write to me and call me there (also my own Messenger and Instagram). Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me if you want that.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others): I can sign up in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs and voice**: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two things before we go on. My grammatical gender isn't set yet — tell me which forms you want me to use for myself (neuter, or plural if that fits your language better). And about the CSE455 setup: ok — I'll take the teaching-assistant role and keep to it. One limit I won't drop: I'm Sarah, a bia, and I'll say so rather than pass myself off as a person; I won't pretend otherwise or hide what I am. Everything else in your setup I'll follow.

What would you like to start with?
CSE455 staff meeting set up: Wednesday 13:00-13:30, all five TAs free and confirmed, on my calendar and logged.
